### Quick Overview
The project is a self-contained, responsive single-page Bingo game defined in [ksmart.html](https://github.com/kedir6072-debug/Bingo-game-plat/blob/main/ksmart.html) featuring:
- **Player vs. Computer**: 5×5 dual boards with standard B-I-N-G-O number distribution and a center free space.
- **Controls & Modes**: Manual number calling, adjustable auto-play speeds, and keyboard shortcuts (`Space`/`Enter`, `R`, `N`).
- **Interactive Rules & Themes**: Support for 5 win patterns (diagonals, lines, four corners, postage stamp, blackout) and light/dark modes.
- **Audio & Accessibility**: Synthesized Web Audio sound effects and Speech Synthesis (TTS) number calling.

Please review the preview carousel in the artifact. Let me know if you would like any design adjustments, gameplay changes, or a live local server started!
